title: The uniqueness of the ground state and the dynamics of nonlinear Schrödinger equation with inverse square potential
summary: In this paper, we first provide an alternative proof of the uniqueness of the ground state solution for NLS with inverse square potential and power nonlinearity $|u|^pu$ for all $0<p<\frac 4{d-2}$ in dimensions $d\ge 3$. While the uniqueness result was previously obtained by Mukherjee-Nam-Nguyen using a functional analytic approach, our method successfully adapts the classical ``shooting method'' to the case with the singular potential, accompanied by a more detailed analysis on the ground state equation.
